children: Fogo said its mainnet was temporarily shut down 10 hours ago as a precaution after unauthorized activity was detected. According to Foresight News, the shutdown was intended to prevent further movement of affected assets.
During the outage, the network will be upgraded to restrict addresses linked to the incident. Fogo said it will share additional updates once more information is confirmed.

title: Fogo Mainnet Temporarily Shuts Down After Unauthorized Activity Is Detected
